description_en: Updates the global configuration of a specific instruction for a Digital Employee
description_zh: 数字员工-全局配置-修改指令
kebab_example: aliyun voicenavigator update-instruction --instance-id 36e9a4cd-a821-4f78-86fa-a9a4aefeea2e --type TRANSFER --code Transfer00 --name '转人工指令一' --config providerId_:_xxxxxxxxx_,_transferMethod_:_BYE_,_transferType_:_External_,_transferTarget_:_152000000_,_transferor_:_0100000_,_timeoutSeconds_:_10 --api-version 2025-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstruction

parameters.description_en: The unique code for the instruction.
parameters.help_en: The unique code for the instruction
parameters.name: code

parameters.description_en:
The configuration for the instruction, specified as a JSON string.

> - `providerId`: The ID of the live agent service provider. Call the `ListCallCenterProviders` operation to obtain this ID.
>
> - `transferMethod`: The method used for the transfer. Valid values: `BYE`, `BRIDGE`, and `REFER`.
>
> - `transferType`: The transfer destination type. Valid values: `External` (external number), `Agent` (agent), and `SkillGroup` (skill group).
>
> - `transferTarget`: The destination of the transfer, such as a phone number, an agent ID, or a skill group ID. The value of this parameter depends on the `transferType`.
>
> - `transferor`: The caller ID to display for the transfer. If this parameter is not specified, the caller's original phone number is used.
>
> - `timeoutSeconds`: The timeout in seconds for transferring a call to an agent. Default: 30.
parameters.description_zh:
指令配置

> - providerId：人工服务提供商id,可通过ListCallCenterProviders 获取
> - transferMethod：转接方式 (BYE，BRIDGE，REFER)
>- transferType：转接目标类型 (External:外部号码, Agent:坐席,SkillGroup:技能组)
>- transferTarget:转接目标
>- transferor:主叫号码(为空则默认使用客户来电手机号码)
>- timeoutSeconds:超时时间，单位：秒（转人工超时时间，默认 30 秒）
